answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 95 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in gale, queued in umber, and voyage publishes the wait time. A farm of 20 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1682 identities would post 3807 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
